title: Simon's missed chance with Noble Sissle
summary: Lawrence got the best breaks; Simon could have gone overseas with Noble Sissle swapping with a French bassist.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

he was a kid. Yeah, then he got sick there.
